title: Design document content
description: The JSON stored in document_revisions.content (JSONB) for every design-core document. Relational metadata (title, slug, status, owner, versions) is NOT duplicated here; it lives in table columns and in the resource envelopes (page.schema.json, template-part.schema.json).

schemaVersion.description: Document contract version. v1 is the only registered version; the server migrates older versions forward on read (see ADR-0005).

grid.description: Dashboard documents only: grid used by the dashboard layout engine.

colorScheme.description: Preferred appearance for this document. `night` uses partStyles; `day` uses partStylesDay.
